body: **31 Oct 2026 — Owner visually approved the original Venezia postcard with the authentic transparent scalloped edge.** Original painting is unchanged; Rialto Bridge feels a little oversized to the owner but is explicitly a later optional redesign, not a release blocker. This scoped art branch commits the 572-point approved-stamp contour and a tested Pillow-based exporter to generate full and tight transparent 1536×1024 PNG + lossless WebP from the existing repository master. It keeps original RGB pixels unchanged; rebuilt SVG-derived edge alpha is a close approximation (a measured 0.1264% of pixels deviate by >64 alpha from owner-reviewed raster matte), so not byte-identical to the original reviewed export. Exact owner-reviewed large PNG/WebP binaries were generated locally but **not pushed** due to connector binary transfer limit; do not claim them as Git files. See `assets/nino/travel-passport/postcards/exports/README.md`. Local generation and lossless WebP vs PNG pixel equality were executed. No app/integration/award logic changed; Hermes integration remains separate, no merge/deploy requested.
